title: The Demonic Path Strikes
next_chapter_hook: Before the Demonic Path commander could finish speaking, a majestic righteous energy crushed down from the depths of the celestial realm. Cang Yutian's voice exploded like thunder: 'This is the celestial realm, not a place for you to run wild.' The confrontation between the three forces suddenly escalated, and Chen Ji's chess game fell into unprecedented chaos.

text.content:
The Fate Writer's cold sneer still echoed in his ears, yet Chen Ji felt the shadows beneath his feet begin to twist—that was his own split shadow, trying to break free from his control.

'See it now?' The Heavenly Eye's voice came from all directions. 'Even the power you trust most is betraying you. A piece chosen by the Tianji Record is ultimately just a discarded pawn.'

Chen Ji did not answer. His pupils reflected that frantically struggling shadow, but his mind was calculating rapidly: shadow betrayal meant the Tianji Record's contract was being interfered with by external forces. Throughout heaven and earth, no more than three beings could accomplish this.

And at that moment, a pitch-black crack split open the firmament.

The aura emanating from that crack was completely opposite to the Heavenly Eye's majestic righteousness—that was demonic energy, the primordial chaos force suppressed by heavenly laws for ten thousand years.

'Interesting.' A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. 'The celestial realm's gates are certainly lively today.'

Before his words finished, a figure slowly walked out from the crack. Clad in black纱, surrounded by crimson demonic fog, every step made the surrounding void tremble. That face was breathtakingly beautiful, yet carried an unsettling aura of evil.

The Demonic Path Commander.

The true Demonic Path Commander, crossing boundaries to arrive.

dialogue.content:
'Chen Ji—'

The Demonic Path Commander's voice carried complex emotions, as if seeing prey she'd waited endlessly for, yet also as if encountering a long-lost old friend.

'Do you know how long I've waited for you?'

She didn't look at the Heavenly Eye, didn't even glance at Cang Yutian's remaining seal. Her gaze, from beginning to end, was locked on Chen Ji.

'Three thousand years. No, thirty thousand. I've lost count.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. Thirty thousand years? He'd heard about the Demonic Path Commander's lifespan—she had at most ten thousand years, unless...

'You are not the current Demonic Path Commander.' Chen Ji's voice was very calm. 'Who are you?'

That woman heard him and actually laughed. Her laughter was clear and pleasant, yet it made the surrounding void begin to distort.

'Sure enough, one chosen by the Tianji Record—smart enough.' She stepped forward slowly, each step pressing against Chen Ji's bottom line. 'Who am I? I'm a Fate Writer candidate erased by heaven ten thousand years ago. Your current opponent is merely a vessel housing my fragmented soul.'

A monstrous wave crashed through Chen Ji's heart. A Fate Writer candidate from ten thousand years ago? Erased by heaven? This meant...

'What are you trying to say?' Chen Ji's voice remained calm, but his clenched fists exposed the turmoil within.

The Demonic Path Commander—or rather, that ten-thousand-year-old soul remnant—lightly raised her hand, and a beam of light condensed in her palm. Within that light appeared a scene, precisely the moment Chen Ji obtained the Tianji Record Fragment.

'Do you think the Tianji Record chose you by chance?' Her voice dripped with mockery. 'Do you think you reached today through your own efforts?'

dialogue.content:
'Enough!'

The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly exploded, and the entire celestial realm trembled.

'Demonic path remnants, how dare you behave so insolently here!'

Yet the Demonic Path Commander merely glanced at it coolly, that gaze carrying a certain high-handed pity.

'What's the rush, Heavenly Eye? Ten thousand years ago you exhausted every scheme to erase me, and now isn't it still only to watch your chess piece fall to my side?'

text.content:
Chen Ji keenly caught the confrontation between the two. The Heavenly Eye and the Demonic Path Commander—were they beings of the same rank ten thousand years ago? Then what he faced now was...

'So you've come to recruit me?' Chen Ji suddenly smiled. 'Join the Demonic Path, oppose heaven? You lost to the Heavenly Eye ten thousand years ago. What makes you think you can win now?'

This remark was毫不客气, even carrying a hint of provocation. The surrounding air solidified, and the Heavenly Eye and Demonic Path Commander both looked at him simultaneously.

One angry, one appreciative.

dialogue.content:
'Because what I offer you is the third path.'

The Demonic Path Commander's voice suddenly became serious.

'Heaven wants you as a vessel for the Tianji Record, to be discarded after use. The Fate Writers want you as a puppet, to control the future through you. But I—'

She paused, her gaze burning as she stared at Chen Ji.

'I can make you a Chess Player. Not anyone's chess piece, but the true, sole Chess Player.'

text.content:
Chess Player.

These three words were like a key, opening a certain closed door in Chen Ji's heart. What had always been his goal? Wasn't it precisely to escape the fate of being a piece, to become the one who moves the pieces?

But he didn't agree immediately.

'What's the condition?' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'You've been plotting for ten thousand years. There must be a condition.'

The Demonic Path Commander smiled—that smile was breathtakingly beautiful, yet dangerously unsettling.

'The condition is simple—kill the Heavenly Eye, or be killed by it.'

dialogue.content:
'Hahaha!'

The Heavenly Eye's laughter shook the entire celestial realm, that laughter carrying undisguised mockery.

'Demonic path remnant, you think such words can shake him? Chen Ji is a smart person—he won't believe your nonsense!'

Yet Chen Ji didn't look at it, but stared at the Demonic Path Commander, slowly speaking:

'How do I know you're not another heaven?'

text.content:
This question made the Demonic Path Commander's smile freeze for an instant.

She didn't answer immediately, but静静地 looked at Chen Ji, that gaze carrying complex emotions—appreciation, regret, and some indescribable expectation.

'Because I've already died once.' She finally spoke. 'Ten thousand years ago I was erased by heaven, my soul shattered into countless fragments. The only meaning to my existence now is one—revenge.'

She paused, her voice becoming low.

'I don't need new chess pieces. I only need a blade that can kill heaven. And you, Chen Ji, are the blade I've waited ten thousand years for.'

The gazes of three forces simultaneously fell on Chen Ji.

The Heavenly Eye: the Chess Player candidate must be recovered.
The Fate Writers: the chess piece has gone out of control, must be destroyed.
The Demonic Path Commander: the blade waited ten thousand years for, must not fall into others' hands.

Yet Chen Ji, standing at the center of these three forces, suddenly smiled.

'Interesting.' His voice was calm. 'So the current situation is—all three of you want to use me, yet all three want to eliminate me?'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't speak, but turned to look at the Fate Writer. 'You want me to be your blade? Fine. First handle this eyesore blocking the way.' His voice was calm. 'This is a matter of sincerity.'

dialogue.content:
The Fate Writer froze for an instant, then burst out laughing: 'Chen Ji, you're insane! You think the Demonic Path remnant would—'

Before she finished speaking, the Demonic Path Commander had already moved.

text.content:
No matter what choice Chen Ji makes, the Demonic Path Commander has demonstrated sufficient sincerity—or rather, threat. Every word, every action of hers proves to Chen Ji: she has this ability, and this determination.

But Chen Ji is also observing.

The Demonic Path Commander's aura, though powerful, carries a certain unstable fluctuation. That is the mark of a soul remnant, indicating her power is incomplete. Ten thousand years of waiting has consumed too much of her.

And the confrontation between the Heavenly Eye and Fate Writer seems not as simple as it appears on the surface. What secrets lie buried in the grievances of ten thousand years ago?

dialogue.content:
Just as the atmosphere僵持到 the extreme, the Heavenly Eye suddenly spoke.

'Chen Ji.' Its voice no longer carried its previous majesty, but had taken on a certain weariness. 'Do you think the Demonic Path Commander came to help you?'

It let out a low, mocking laugh.

'What she needs is not an ally, but a vessel. When she was erased ten thousand years ago, it was because she sought a suitable vessel for rebirth. Do you think the Tianji Record chose you by chance? That was her behind-the-scenes push!'

text.content:
This sentence was like a basin of cold water poured over Chen Ji's head.

The Tianji Record choosing him was pushed by the Demonic Path Commander?

He recalled the moment he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment. That truly was by chance—he picked up a page of ancient, battered scripture in the ruins, and from then on his fate changed dramatically.

But thinking about it now, those ruins... the location of those ruins seemed too coincidental.

'You're lying!' The Demonic Path Commander's expression finally changed. 'The will of the Tianji Record, how could I possibly influence it!'

text.content:
The words of the three forces intertwined, the boundary between truth and lies becoming increasingly blurred.

Chen Ji stood in the center, yet his heart was racing.

The Heavenly Eye wanted him to hate the Demonic Path Commander, thus completely turning him toward heaven. The Demonic Path Commander wanted him to believe only she could help him escape the fate of being a piece. And the Fate Writer...

He looked at that existence simultaneously suppressed by the Heavenly Eye and Demonic Path Commander, suddenly realizing one thing: all three were vying for him, but none gave him complete truth.

There must be something he didn't know among this.

And that thing is the true key.

dialogue.content:
'Enough!'

The Demonic Path Commander suddenly roared, black demonic energy surging forth like a tide.

'Chen Ji, no matter what they say, my conditions remain unchanged. Kill the Heavenly Eye, and I'll give you everything you desire.'

She paused, her voice suddenly becoming low.

'Including... the whereabouts of your sister.'

These words were like a thunderbolt, striking Chen Ji's heart.

Chen Nian!

His sister who had been missing for years, the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' taken away by the Holy Sect!

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

This was his weakness. Finding Chen Nian had always been his core drive. If the Demonic Path Commander truly knew Chen Nian's whereabouts...

'Do you know where she is?' Chen Ji's voice became hoarse, the result of him极力suppressed his emotions.

The Demonic Path Commander's lips curved into a meaningful smile.

'I know far more than you imagine. The Holy Sect took her, but not for any 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' They want to use her...' She paused. 'To unseal heaven's封印.'

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully pressing down the churning emotions. 'Regarding Chen Nian's matter, I will naturally investigate it.' His voice returned to calm. 'What I want to know now is—what exactly do you want?'

dialogue.content: A flash of appreciation crossed the Demonic Path Commander's eyes. 'Good, able to remain calm upon hearing news of your sister. You're even more outstanding than I anticipated.' She smiled. 'But you'll come back eventually, Chen Ji. Because you need me.'

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji contemplated how to respond to the Demonic Path Commander's proposal, a brilliant golden light suddenly erupted from the depths of the firmament.

The power contained within that golden light made even the Demonic Path Commander's expression change.

'This is...'

A figure walked out from the golden light—a middle-aged man in plain white robes, his features elegant and temperament transcendent. But his gaze carried an overwhelming majesty that none could face directly.

Cang Yutian.

The Celestial Realm Guardian, the true controller behind the three great sects, had finally revealed himself.

'This is the celestial realm, not a place for you to run wild.' His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. 'Demonic path remnant, withdraw immediately!'

dialogue.content:
The Demonic Path Commander's expression grew gloomy. Though powerful, facing a being like Cang Yutian, she had no assured victory.

'Cang Yutian...' Her voice carried a chill. 'So you've finally shown yourself?'

The two faced each other, the air between them filled with剑拔弩张 tension.

Yet Chen Ji, standing at the center of this storm, suddenly felt an strange calm.

The three forces had finally gathered. And he—才是这场博弈中最大的变数。
